name: Gendarme-Dragoon (CR 22)
body:
GENDARME-DRAGOON
CR 22

Male middle–aged human cavalier 10 (gendarme)/fighter 9 (Dragoon)/champion 7
LG Medium humanoid (human)
Initiative +11, amazing initiative; Senses Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 36, touch 12, flat–footed 34 (+11 armor, +2 Dexterity, +5 natural, +8 shield), +4 dodge while charging vs. set against attacks (mounted mastery); +3 dodge when challenged (knight errant’s challenge)
hp 210 (19d10 + 57 + 35 + 4)
Fort +21, Ref +13, Will +16; +2 morale on Will while LG (by my honor); +2 vs. fear (bravery); +2 vs. divine spells and spell–like abilities (Divine Defiance); +2 vs. spells and abilities of evil outsiders (redeemed lance); +4 morale vs. fear during a charge (banner); +4 on Fort saves vs. hot or cold environments and damage from suffocation (Endurance).
Defensive Abilities armor training +1, bravery +2, defy death, elemental fury, force of will, hard to kill, mythic saves, self reliant, without master; DR 5/magic (with magic armor); Immune non-mythic curses and compulsions; SR 30 vs. divine spells and spell–like abilities.

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee stormcaller +31/+26/+21/+16 (1d8+15 +1d6 electricity, 19-20/x3), +2 redeemed thundering lance +32/+27/+22/+17 (1d8+16, +2d6 damage vs. evil creatures, x3 +2d8 sonic), rod of thunder and lightning +28/+23/+18/+13 (1d6+9); +35, +36, or +32 (2d6+23, 2d6+24, or 1d8+16) in a charge while mounted
Ranged stormcaller +26 (1d8+9/19-20/x3)
Special Attacks banner +5/+4, cavalier’s charge, challenge 4/day (+10 damage and +3 to hit while riding mount, +3 morale bonus on attack when challenged), elemental fury, fleet charge, mounted maniac, mythic power 17/day, spear training +2, spinning lance, surge +1d10, without master
Spell–like Abilities (CL 19, concentration +24)

At will (spending mythic power)—obscuring mist, fog cloud, call lightning (DC 18), sleet storm, call lightning storm (DC 20), sirocco (DC 21), control weather
1/day—commune

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 15, Con 16, Int 14, Wis 16, Cha 20
Base Atk +19; CMB +26 (+28 with bull rush and overrun); CMD 38 (42 vs. disarm and sunder when wielding a weapon of the spear group)
Traits Adopted, Bound by Honor, Warrior of Old
Feats Combat Expertise (+5/–5), Death from Above *, Death or Glory (+6), Diehard M, Divine Defiance, Endurance, Focused Disbelief, Greater Weapon Focus (spear group), Heroic Will, Horse Master, Iron Will M, Mounted Combat *, Mythic Mount M, Mythic Weapon Training M (1/day), Skill Focus (Ride)*, Power Attack * (–5/+10), Ride–By Attack *, Shield Focus, Spirited Charge *, Trample *, Weapon Focus * (spears group), Weapon Specialization * (spears group)
Skills Acrobatics +12, Diplomacy +18, Fly +12, Handle Animal +18/+23, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (nobility) +15, Knowledge (planes) +12/+17, Knowledge (religion) +14, Perception +12, Ride +25, Sense Motive +15/+20, Survival +15
Languages Common, Elven, Infernal
SQ champion’s strike (fleet charge), expert trainer, mythic mount (sky panther named Bragh), order of the knight errant (self reliant, without master), order of the sword (by my honor [Will], mounted mastery), path abilities (defy death, elemental fury, mortal herald [Weather/Storms], mounted maniac, mythic weapon training [spears], mythic order [Knight–Captain], pure destiny), skilled rider.
Gear stormcaller, +2 redeemed thundering lance, rod of thunder and lightning (33,000 gp), +5 invulnerability jousting agile breastplate, +5 clangorous heraldic moderate fortification heavy steel shield, amulet of natural armor +5, belt of thunderous charging, cape of free will +5/+6, lord’s banner of terror, ring of heartbeat, ring of inner fortitude, minor, staff of electricity, stormcrusher gauntlets (45,000 gp), thunder strap
